models_evaluated: transfer-learning CNN classifier for chest X-ray (no pneumonia, COVID-19 pneumonia, non-COVID pneumonia)
total variation minimization with patch-based regularization denoising

links.outcome: Classifier accuracy under FGSM adversarial attack, before and after total variation denoising
links.effect: Average accuracy fell from 95.56% to 19.83% under adversarial attack; after denoising it rose from 19.83% to 88.23% on adversarial images.
links.quote: Post-denoising, the model exhibits a remarkable accuracy improvement, surging from 19.83 to 88.23% on adversarial images.

unlisted_practices: Total variation minimization and patch-based denoising of input images as a defense against adversarial noise

screen.reason: The study tests an input filtering safeguard (total variation minimization and patch-based regularization denoising) to defend diagnostic image classification models against adversarial noise attacks.

primary.practice: adversarial noise defense via input denoising filter
